pages.title: Eventore — Multi-stream messaging console
pages.description: Unified open-source console for Kafka, MQTT, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, JMS, Kinesis, GCP Pub/Sub, and Azure Service Bus. Live streaming, inspection, Helm on Kubernetes.
pages.keywords: kafka console, mqtt broker ui, multi-protocol messaging, event streaming, kubernetes helm, rabbitmq admin, pulsar tools

pages.title: Product guide — Eventore
pages.description: Eventore documentation hub: deploy, configure connections, stream live messages, inspect brokers, and run on Kubernetes with Helm.
pages.keywords: eventore documentation, messaging console guide, kafka deployment

pages.title: Getting started — Eventore
pages.description: Install Eventore locally or on Kubernetes, create your first broker connection, and start a live message stream in about five minutes.
pages.keywords: eventore install, kafka quick start, messaging console tutorial

pages.title: Architecture — Eventore
pages.description: How Eventore splits control plane and data plane, modular Spring Boot providers, React UI, WebSocket streaming, and OpenAPI APIs.
pages.keywords: eventore architecture, control plane data plane, spring boot streaming

pages.title: Control & data plane — Eventore
pages.description: Learn how Eventore registers stream providers on the control plane while the data plane handles broker connections, publish, and inspect.
pages.keywords: control plane, stream provider registration, eventore data plane

pages.title: MCP for AI agents — Eventore
pages.description: Use the optional Eventore MCP server with Cursor and Claude to probe brokers, publish messages, and inspect streams via AI agents.
pages.keywords: model context protocol, mcp kafka, ai agent messaging, eventore mcp

pages.title: Configuration — Eventore
pages.description: Configure Eventore with application.yml, environment variables, Helm values, Maven profiles, and ADMIN, DEV, or READONLY modes.
pages.keywords: eventore configuration, helm values, deployment modes readonly

pages.title: Connections — Eventore
pages.description: Create and test broker connection profiles in Eventore with cloud presets for MSK, Azure Event Hubs, GCP Pub/Sub, and secure credentials.
pages.keywords: kafka connection profile, msk preset, broker credentials

pages.title: Stream platforms — Eventore
pages.description: Supported wire protocols and cloud presets in Eventore: Kafka, MQTT, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, JMS, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, and Azure Service Bus.
pages.keywords: kafka mqtt rabbitmq pulsar, aws kinesis console, azure service bus ui

pages.title: Streaming & live view — Eventore
pages.description: Multi-topic WebSocket live view in Eventore with regex filters, timed capture windows, and JSON, CSV, or NDJSON export.
pages.keywords: kafka live stream ui, websocket message viewer, event stream export

pages.title: Inspection — Eventore
pages.description: Browse topics and queues, consumer groups, lag, and message search across every stream protocol registered in Eventore.
pages.keywords: kafka consumer lag ui, message search, queue inspection

pages.title: Kafka admin — Eventore
pages.description: Manage Kafka topics, ACLs, produce with headers, and cluster operations from Eventore when the Kafka provider is enabled in ADMIN mode.
pages.keywords: kafka topic admin ui, kafka acl management, produce with headers

pages.title: Deployment — Eventore
pages.description: Deploy Eventore with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. GHCR images per protocol, OCI charts, slim builds, ingress, and optional MCP pod.
pages.keywords: eventore helm chart, ghcr kubernetes, kafka kinesis slim image
